title: $\Kab$ has the Bogomolov property for canonical heights
summary: We show that for any number field $K$ and any rational map $f$ in $K(x)$ that is not conjugate to a power, (signed) Chebyshev or Lattès map, then $K^{\mathrm{ab}}$ has the strong Bogomolov property for the canonical height of $f$. We also classify the pairs $(f,α)$ whose backward orbit contains infinitely many abelian points. This settles the Andrews--Petsche conjecture to rational maps over a number field and to infinite abelian subsets of backward orbits.
